name: Havarti, Peach, Tomato & Basil "Grilled" Cheese Sandwiches on Sourdough

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Slice tomatoes crosswise into thin rounds. Place on a plate.

Quarter peaches lengthwise (around the pit); twist quarters to separate, then remove and discard pits. Slice each quarter into thin wedges and add to the plate with the tomato. Season tomatoes and peaches with spices.
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ tsp garlic powder
¼ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons. Add to the plate.

Arrange half of the bread slices on a baking sheet pan, layer each with 1 1/2 slices of cheese, tomato slices, peach wedges, and basil. Top each with another 1 1/2 slices of cheese, then close sandwiches with remaining bread slices.
instructions.secondary_message:
8 slice sourdough bread
12 slice Havarti cheese, sliced

instructions.primary_message: Preheat an outdoor grill or grill pan over medium-high heat.
While the grill heats up, spread mayo on the top side of the sandwiches.
Once the grill is hot, add sandwiches, mayo-side down, and grill until bottoms are golden, 2-4 minutes. (Reserve baking sheet for the next step.)

Remove sandwiches to the baking sheet, grilled-side down, and spread the other side with additional mayo. Return sandwiches, mayo-side down, to the grill and continue to cook until golden on the other side and cheese is melted, 2-4 minutes more. Transfer to a cutting board.
To serve, slice sandwiches in half and divide between plates. Enjoy!
